description: Ministry of Provincial Roads, Transport Cooperative Development Western Province - Closure of Liquidation The Co-operative Societies under the Co-operatative Societies Statute No. 03 of 1998
reasoning: This gazette notification announces the closure of liquidation for multiple co-operative societies under the Co-operative Societies Statute. The content deals specifically with business/commercial matters - the formal dissolution and liquidation completion of registered business entities (co-operative societies). This falls under Commercial Gazettes (Type 6) as it involves corporate dissolutions and business registrations, not government personnel/structure, land, legal frameworks, elections, public service, judicial matters, or other specialized categories.
